newsitem.title: POLAND: NO JOBLESS STUNTMEN AND UMPIRES IN POLAND.
newsitem.headline: NO JOBLESS STUNTMEN AND UMPIRES IN POLAND.

text.p: Although unemployment in Poland now stands at 12.4 percent, down from 13 percent last month, there were no stuntment, sports referees or sedimentologists among the jobless, PAP news agency said on Monday.
Other occupations with full employment include goat-rearing and lampshade-making, said the report based partly on registrations at employment offices.

Among the new occupations which have emerged since the collapse of communism in 1989, the unemployed included 52 employment-agency workers, 17 tax advisers, some 2,000 security guards and more than 200 advertising agents.
Unemployment dropped last year compared with 1995 among bootblacks, journalists and mayonnaise-production workers.
In the same period, unemployment grew slightly among film actors, chewing-gum-production workers, magicians and foster mothers.
